message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to make live requests to external services like VirusTotal. If you’d like to retrieve the comments yourself, you can use the VirusTotal API with your key. Here’s a quick example of how you might do it in Python:

```python
import requests

api_key = "GHI654"
ip_address = "203.0.113.0"
limit = 25
cursor = "nop"

url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{ip_address}/comments"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": api_key,
}
params = {
    "limit": limit,
    "cursor": cursor,
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
if response.status_code == 200:
    data = response.json()
    print(data)
else:
    print(f"Error {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
```

Make sure you have the `requests` library installed (`pip install requests`) and replace the placeholder values with your actual API key and desired parameters.
